name: UNSW Gateway Scholarship
summary: Yearly scholarship for commencing students admitted through the Gateway Admission Pathway from a Gateway Partner School.
key: $10,000 per annum for the minimum duration of program.
who: Commencing undergraduate admitted via the Gateway Admission Pathway
how: Considered automatically through your Gateway application
catches: 2027 rounds: EAS via UAC by 19 Nov 2026, ES by 10 Dec 2026, with later January and February rounds; offers made through to March 2027
Competitive; meeting the criteria does not guarantee an award

source.label: UNSW Scholarships: UNSW Equity Scholarships for 2027

evidence.quote: Supports commencing students enrolled through the Gateway Admission Pathway who attended a Gateway Partner School.
